biochemFlow.title: Production flow · Biochem
biochemFlow.subtitle: Who does each step of a batch and what must be true before the next one starts · the states and counts come from the database
biochemFlow.whoHint: Choose a step for its details · green steps are the two QC gates
biochemFlow.statesNote: No state can be skipped. Bulk failed and QC rejected end in close; a batch can be cancelled only before material goes to it. The person who made or packed a batch can't release it in QC.
biochemFlow.gates: QC gates: bulk test, finished-lot release

masters.name: Licence and masters
masters.what: Record the licence, products and places.
masters.must: The licence number and dates come from the original paper.

formula.name: Formula approved
formula.what: Write the formula and send it for approval; another person approves it.
formula.must: Bulk by weight, packaging in Nos, QC limits; the writer can't approve.

plan.name: Plan batch
plan.what: Choose the product, the bulk to make and the places.
plan.must: An approved formula in force on the date and a valid licence for the family.

reserve.name: Reserve materials
reserve.what: Reserve the formula's bulk materials at the stores.
reserve.must: Enough released stock, net of other reservations.

weigh.name: Weigh and check
weigh.what: Weigh each material; a second person checks it and it leaves the stores.
weigh.must: Released lots only; scale within calibration; the weigher can't check.

make.name: Make
make.what: Start the batch and send the bulk sample with the bulk weight.

bulk.name: Bulk test
bulk.what: Test the bulk sample against the QC limits.
bulk.must: A pass outside the limits is refused; the instrument is calibrated.

pack.name: Fill and pack
pack.what: Issue packaging, record good and rejected packs; packs go on hold.
pack.must: Packaging in whole Nos; the reconciliation is computed.

release.name: Release finished lot
release.what: Test the finished lot, then release or reject it.
release.must: A passed bulk and finished test; never by anyone who made the batch.

close.name: Close and cost
close.what: Close the batch; its cost sheet is fixed.
close.must: Packaging and bulk reconcile (or the batch can't close).

receiving.title: Receiving
receiving.body: Goods receipt with supplier lot and expiry → quarantine → incoming test → released lot. Nothing is weighed from quarantine.

rework.title: Deviation and rework
rework.body: A failed bulk or finished test ends in QC reject with a reason; rework runs as a new batch.

recall.title: Complaint and recall
recall.body: Each lot keeps its batch, materials and tests, so a complaint traces back to the materials and forward to customers.

licence.title: Licence
licence.body: A missing or lapsed licence blocks planning and every production step of the families that need it.

waste.title: Waste
waste.body: Bulk scrapped and packaging scrapped are recorded at packing and reconciled; a difference opens a Bug fixer item.

cost.title: Cost per batch
cost.body: Materials and packaging at lot rates, plus labour, machine and overhead at the rates Admin sets; missing rates are listed, never invented.
